import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Set;

public class Main {
    public static boolean checkProperty(int[] f, int p, int k) {
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (f[(k * i) % p] != (k * f[i]) % p) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static int enumerateF(int[] f, int p, int k, int index) {
        if (index == p) {
            return checkProperty(f, p, k) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int val = 0; val < p; val++) {
            f[index] = val;
            total += enumerateF(f, p, k, index + 1);
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static long solve(int p, int k) {
        long totalGroups = 0;
        Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();
        for (int j = 0; j < p; j++) {
            if (!visited.contains(j)) {
                totalGroups++;
            }
            int i = j;
            while (!visited.contains(i)) {
                visited.add(i);
                i = (i * k) % p;
            }
        }
        long mod = 1000000007L;
        long exponent = totalGroups - (k != 1 ? 1 : 0);
        return pow(p, exponent, mod);
    }

    public static long pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1L;
        long curr = base % mod;
        long e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * curr) % mod;
            }
            curr = (curr * curr) % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();
        System.out.println(solve(p, k));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
